faqs.q: What is the minimum hourly rate for a law graduate under the Legal Services Award?
faqs.a: From 1 July 2026, the Legal Services Award 2020 sets the minimum hourly rate for a Level 5 law graduate at $33.99 per hour for full-time employees. This rate applies to ordinary hours (38 per week) and does not include casual loading or penalties. Casual employees receive an additional 25% loading, making the casual minimum $42.49 per hour.

faqs.q: How does casual loading affect a lawyer salary Sydney?

This loading replaces entitlements like paid leave and is paid on top of the base rate. ## Lawyer Salary Sydney: Converting Hourly to Annual for 2026–27

Understanding your pay as a lawyer in Sydney starts with the base rate. Whether you are a legal graduate, a law clerk, or a senior associate, the conversion from hourly to annual follows a simple formula: **hourly rate × hours per week × 52 weeks**. For most full-time roles, the standard week is 38 ordinary hours under the Legal Services Award 2020. This article explains how to calculate your annual salary, the role of award minimums, casual loading, superannuation, and tax, using the latest figures from the Fair Work Ombudsman, the Australian Bureau of Statistics, and the Australian Taxation Office.

### The 38-Hour Week and the Fortnight

A full-time employee under the Legal Services Award works 38 ordinary hours per week. To find your annual gross pay, multiply your hourly rate by 38, then by 52. For example, a Level 5 law graduate on the minimum $33.99 per hour earns $33.99 × 38 = $1,291.62 per week, or $1,291.62 × 52 = $67,164.24 per year. Many employers pay fortnightly, so your fortnightly gross would be $1,291.62 × 2 = $2,583.24. This calculation assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, and no penalty rates. For a more precise estimate, use the timesheet on this site.

### Award Minimums vs. National Minimum Wage

The Fair Work Ombudsman’s Legal Services Award 2020 sets minimum hourly rates for legal clerical and administrative employees, law graduates, and law clerks. From 1 July 2026, these rates increased by 4.75%. Key minimums include:

- Level 1 legal clerical: $28.24 per hour
- Level 3 legal clerical: $31.11 per hour
- Level 5 law graduate: $33.99 per hour
- Level 6 law clerk: $36.03 per hour

These are the minimums for full-time employees. The National Minimum Wage is lower at $26.44 per hour, but award-covered roles must pay at least the award rate. If you are a casual employee, you receive a 25% loading on top of the minimum hourly rate. For instance, a casual law graduate earns $33.99 × 1.25 = $42.49 per hour. When using the timesheet, enter your base hourly rate without loading, then check the casual loading box to add 25% on top.

### Typical Lawyer Salary Sydney: ABS Averages

While award rates provide a floor, actual lawyer salaries in Sydney are often higher. The Australian Bureau of Statistics’ Average Weekly Earnings for May 2026 show full-time adult ordinary time earnings of $2,083.70 per week. For a 38-hour week, that equates to an hourly rate of about $54.83 ($2,083.70 ÷ 38). Multiplying by 52 gives an annual gross of approximately $108,352. This figure is a useful benchmark for a typical lawyer salary Sydney, though it includes all occupations. For legal professionals specifically, salaries can range from $70,000 for graduates to over $200,000 for partners.

### Superannuation and Tax

Superannuation is paid on top of your ordinary earnings. From 1 July 2026, the super guarantee rate is 12% of ordinary time earnings, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830. For a law graduate earning $67,164, the employer would contribute $8,059.40 per year. This is not deducted from your pay; it is an additional benefit. Tax is calculated using the 2026–27 resident rates: nil on the first $18,200, then 15% on the next $26,800, then 30% up to $45,000, and so on. The Medicare levy is generally 2% of taxable income. The take-home pay calculator on this site uses the 2026–27 scale with the full tax-free threshold.

### Using the Timesheet and Reference Tables

To estimate your own pay, start at the timesheet. Enter your base hourly rate, then adjust for casual loading if applicable. The reference tables provide award rates, minimum wage, and average earnings. For a quick conversion, use the hourly conversion tool. Remember that these are estimates and do not include penalty rates, allowances, or salary packaging.

### Summary

A lawyer salary Sydney depends on your classification, experience, and employer. The Legal Services Award sets minimums, but many earn above. Use the formula hourly × 38 × 52 to get annual gross. Add super at 12% on top, and apply the tax scale for net pay. For casual roles, add 25% loading. Always refer to the Fair Work Ombudsman for your specific award, and the Australian Taxation Office for your tax obligations.
